title: एकादशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 111 · The best of the holy places

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks what is the best of all holy places and where lies the highest purity. Bhishma says that the best tirthas are those in the body, the truthful, the self-controlled, the knowing and those without craving, and speaks of the two purities, of the body and of the place, that bring perfection.
summary.kn: ಎಲ್ಲ ತೀರ್ಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠವಾದುದು ಯಾವುದು, ಪರಮ ಶುದ್ಧಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆಯೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸರ್ವತ್ಯಾಗಿ, ಸರ್ವಜ್ಞ, ಸತ್ಯ, ಜಿತೇಂದ್ರಿಯ ದೇಹಸ್ಥ ತೀರ್ಥಗಳೇ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠ, ದೇಹಶುದ್ಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ತೀರ್ಥಶುದ್ಧಿ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಶುದ್ಧಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि सब तीर्थों में श्रेष्ठ क्या है और परम शुद्धि कहाँ है। भीष्म कहते हैं कि सर्वत्यागी, सर्वज्ञ, सत्यवादी और जितेन्द्रिय देहस्थ तीर्थ सबसे श्रेष्ठ हैं, और देह-शुद्धि तथा तीर्थ-शुद्धि दो शुद्धियाँ सिद्धि देती हैं।
summary.te: అన్ని తీర్థాలలో శ్రేష్ఠమైనది ఏది, పరమ శుద్ధి ఎక్కడని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. సర్వత్యాగులు, సర్వజ్ఞులు, సత్యవంతులు, జితేంద్రియులైన దేహస్థ తీర్థాలే శ్రేష్ఠమని, శరీర శుద్ధి, తీర్థ శుద్ధి అనే రెండు శుద్ధులు సిద్ధినిస్తాయని భీష్ముడు అంటాడు.
summary.ta: எல்லாத் தீர்த்தங்களிலும் சிறந்தது எது, உயர்ந்த தூய்மை எங்குள்ளது என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, எல்லாம் துறந்தோர், எல்லாம் அறிந்தோர், உண்மையாளர், புலனடக்கியோர் ஆகிய உடலிலுள்ள தீர்த்தங்களே சிறந்தவை, உடல் தூய்மை தீர்த்த தூய்மை இரண்டும் சித்தி தரும் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: എല്ലാ പുണ്യസ്ഥലങ്ങളിലും ഏറ്റവും ശ്രേഷ്ഠമായതേത്, ഏറ്റവും ഉയർന്ന ശുദ്ധി എവിടെയാണെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ശരീരത്തിനകത്തുള്ള തീർത്ഥങ്ങളും, സത്യവാനും ആത്മനിയന്ത്രണമുള്ളവനും അറിവുള്ളവനും ആഗ്രഹമില്ലാത്തവനുമുള്ള തീർത്ഥങ്ങളുമാണ് ഏറ്റവും ശ്രേഷ്ഠമെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; പരിപൂർണ്ണതയിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുന്ന ശരീരത്തിന്റെയും സ്ഥലത്തിന്റെയും രണ്ടു ശുദ്ധികളെക്കുറിച്ചും അദ്ദേഹം സംസാരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.111; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
यद्वरं सर्वतीर्थानां तद्ब्रवीहि पितामह ।
यत्र वै परमं शौचं तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, tell me which is the best of all holy places, where the highest purity is found; you ought to explain this to me.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
सर्वाणि खलु तीर्थानि गुणवन्ति मनीषिणाम् ।
यत्तु तीर्थं च शौचं च तन्मे शृणु समाहितः ॥

meaning.en: All holy places are indeed beneficial for the wise; but listen attentively to me about what is both a holy place and purity.

verses.text:
अगाधे विमले शुद्धे सत्यतोये धृतिह्रदे ।
स्नातव्यं मानसे तीर्थे सत्त्वमालम्ब्य शाश्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: One should bathe in the holy place of the mind, resting on lasting goodness: a deep, clear, pure water whose water is truth and whose lake is steadfastness.

verses.text:
तीर्थशौचमनर्थित्वमार्दवं सत्यमार्जवम् ।
अहिंसा सर्वभूतानामानृशंस्यं दमः शमः ॥

meaning.en: The purity of a holy place is freedom from wants, gentleness, truthfulness, honesty, non-violence toward all creatures, kindness, self-control and tranquillity.

verses.text:
निर्ममा निरहंकारा निर्द्वंद्वा निष्परिग्रहाः ।
शुचयस्तीर्थभूतास्ते ये भैक्षमुपभुञ्जते ॥

meaning.en: Those who are free of possessiveness and ego, beyond the pairs of opposites, without belongings, and who live on alms, are pure and are themselves holy places.

verses.text:
तत्त्ववित्त्वनहंबुद्धिस्तीर्थं परममुच्यते ।
शौचलक्षणमेतत्ते सर्वत्रैवान्ववेक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: A knower of truth without the sense of ego is called the supreme holy place; this is the mark of purity for you: seeing the same everywhere.

verses.text:
रजस्तमः सत्त्वमथो येषां निर्धौतमात्मनः ।
शौचाशौचे न ते सक्ताः स्वकार्यपरिमार्गिणः ॥

meaning.en: Those whose self has been washed clean of rajas, tamas and sattva are not attached to purity or impurity, and they pursue their own proper aim.

verses.text:
सर्वत्यागेष्वभिरताः सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः ।
शौचेन वृत्तशौचार्थास्ते तीर्थाः शुचयश्च ते ॥

meaning.en: Those delighted in renouncing everything, all-knowing and all-seeing, whose purity lies in purifying conduct, are holy places and pure.

verses.text:
नोदकक्लिन्नगात्रस्तु स्नात इत्यभिधीयते ।
स स्नातो यो दमस्नातः सबाह्याभ्यन्तरः शुचिः ॥

meaning.en: One is not called bathed merely because the body is wet with water; he who is bathed in self-control is pure within and without.

verses.text:
अतीतेष्वनपेक्षा ये प्राप्तेष्वर्थेषु निर्ममाः ।
शौचमेव परं तेषां येषां नोत्पद्यते स्पृहा ॥

meaning.en: Those who have no longing for what is past and no possessiveness over what has come, and in whom no craving arises, have the highest purity.

verses.text:
प्रज्ञानं शौचमेवेह शरीरस्य विशेषतः ।
तथा निष्किंचनत्वं च मनसश्च प्रसन्नता ॥

meaning.en: Here, for the body especially, purity is true knowledge, as are owning nothing and a serene mind.

verses.text:
वृत्तशौचं मनःशौचं तीर्थशौचं परं हितम् ।
ज्ञानोत्पन्नं च यच्छौचं तच्छौचं परमं मतम् ॥

meaning.en: Purity of conduct, purity of mind and the purity of holy places are most beneficial; the purity born of knowledge is held to be the highest.

verses.text:
मनसाथ प्रदीपेन ब्रह्मज्ञानबलेन च ।
स्नाता ये मानसे तीर्थे तज्ज्ञाः क्षेत्रज्ञदर्शिनः ॥

meaning.en: Those who have bathed in the holy place of the mind, with the lamp of the mind and the strength of knowledge of Brahman, know it and see the knower of the field.

verses.text:
समारोपितशौचस्तु नित्यं भावसमन्वितः ।
केवलं गुणसंपन्नः शुचिरेव नरः सदा ॥

meaning.en: A man in whom purity is firmly established, always possessed of right feeling and endowed with virtues alone, is always pure.

verses.text:
शरीरस्थानि तीर्थानि प्रोक्तान्येतानि भारत ।
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यानि शृणु तान्यपि ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, these are the holy places that are in the body; now hear about the sacred holy places on earth.

verses.text:
यथा शरीरस्योद्देशाः शुचयः परिनिर्मिताः ।
तथा पृथिव्या भागाश्च पुण्यानि सलिलानि च ॥

meaning.en: Just as the parts of the body are made pure, so are parts of the earth and its waters sacred.

verses.text:
प्रार्थनाच्चैव तीर्थस्य स्नानाच्च पितृतर्पणात् ।
धुनन्ति पापं तीर्थेषु पूता यान्ति दिवं सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: By resorting to a holy place, bathing, and offering water to ancestors, people shake off sin at holy places and, purified, go happily to heaven.

verses.text:
परिग्रहाच्च साधूनां पृथिव्याश्चैव तेजसा ।
अतीव पुण्यास्ते भागाः सलिलस्य च तेजसा ॥

meaning.en: Through the presence of the virtuous, the power of the earth and the power of the water, those places become exceedingly holy.

verses.text:
मनसश्च पृथिव्याश्च पुण्यतीर्थास्तथापरे ।
उभयोरेव यः स्नातः स सिद्धिं शीघ्रमाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: There are other holy places holy by mind and by earth; one who bathes in both quickly attains perfection.

verses.text:
यथा बलं क्रियाहीनं क्रिया वा बलवर्जिता ।
नेह साधयते कार्यं समायुक्तस्तु सिध्यति ॥

meaning.en: As strength without action, or action without strength, does not accomplish a task here, but the two joined succeed,

verses.text:
एवं शरीरशौचेन तीर्थशौचेन चान्वितः ।
ततः सिद्धिमवाप्नोति द्विविधं शौचमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: so one endowed with purity of body and purity of holy places then attains perfection; the twofold purity is the best.
